description: This file defines a Python language generator class for code generation in the Playwright testing framework, including methods for generating test scripts, handling actions, and formatting code snippets.

classes.name: PythonLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class implementing the LanguageGenerator interface for generating Python code for Playwright tests, supporting async and PyTest modes.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Python code for a given action in the test context, handling different action types like click, fill, navigate, and assertions.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Creates the header part of the Python test script, including imports and setup code based on options.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer part of the script, closing contexts and browsers, with variations for async and sync modes.
